LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.0.label: Crystal Guidance
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.0.descriptio: Requires Crystal Bolt learned from its augment card. Retains its original projectile, travel time, damage and cooldown; this tree does not teach the skill.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.1.label: Crystal Fork
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.1.descriptio: After Crystal Bolt actually damages an enemy, strike one other enemy within 4 cells of the impact and clear sight for 50 bonus damage, once per 8 seconds. With no other enemy, it does not strike the original target again. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.2.label: Crystal Imprint
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.2.descriptio: After Crystal Bolt actually damages an enemy, mark it for 6 seconds. One mark, created once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Other targets and secondary damage cannot consume it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.3.label: Fork Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.3.descriptio: After Crystal Fork actually damages a second enemy, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Missing parts and permanent scars are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.4.label: Crystal Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.4.descriptio: After Crystal Fork actually damages a second enemy, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.5.label: Shattered Imprint
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.5.descriptio: After your Crystal Imprint bonus deals damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. It cannot strike the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.6.label: Imprint Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Arc014.nodes.6.descriptio: After your Crystal Imprint bonus deals damage, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Creating a mark alone grants no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
